text: understanding: Heb. an heart | I am not inferior to you: Heb. I fall not lower then you | who knoweth not such things as these?: With whom are not such as these?
soul: Or, life | all mankind: Heb. all flesh of man
with him: That is, with God
the speech of the trusty: Heb. the lip of the faithful
weakeneth the strength of the mighty: Or, looseth the girdle of the strong
